AccessCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax access cookie. Local development uses the unprefixed bojro_access cookie; runtime lookup follows the active environment.
AccessCookie.name: __Host-bojro_access

AdminAccessCookie.description: Dedicated HttpOnly Secure admin access cookie. Development uses the unprefixed bojro_admin_access name. It is never accepted by customer endpoints.
AdminAccessCookie.name: __Host-bojro_admin_access

AdminRefreshCookie.description: Dedicated rotating admin refresh cookie scoped to /api/v1/admin/auth with an eight-hour absolute and thirty-minute idle policy.
AdminRefreshCookie.name: __Secure-bojro_admin_refresh

GuestCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax __Host-bojro_guest cookie. Local development uses bojro_guest; runtime lookup follows the active environment.
GuestCookie.name: __Host-bojro_guest

RefreshCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax __Secure-bojro_refresh cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth. Local development uses bojro_refresh; runtime lookup follows the active environment.
RefreshCookie.name: __Secure-bojro_refresh
